instructions: Calm, warm science-documentary narrator. Unhurried, clear articulation, a brief pause between sentences.

lines.text: For contrast, here is a periodic attractor of the same loop, a little further along the steering line. These are five hundred trajectories, recorded from their very first step. Each color is the most probable next token.

Wherever they begin, they pour in toward the same eight states: five hundred and nine of the five hundred and twelve end up on them. The faint streams are the trajectories on their way in; the eight bright knots are the attractor itself.
Once a trajectory arrives, it hops around those eight states forever, and the most probable tokens repeat in the same order again and again: this is there is a is a.
Order and chaos sit side by side in the same model. A small change of the steering turns these eight knots into a chaotic attractor.
